articles.title: OpenAI faces new regulation push in Brussels
articles.sentence: EU officials said on Thursday that OpenAI would be among the first companies subject to the new regulation, which takes effect next year and applies to every general-purpose model provider operating in the bloc.

articles.title: Authors widen lawsuit against OpenAI
articles.context: "We are asking the court to hold OpenAI accountable," the plaintiffs' lawyer told reporters.
